summary_en: KOHNAN SHOJI authorized acquisition of up to 450,000 shares (1.51% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of JPY 1.5 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 14, 2026 to February 28, 2027, to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision of Matters Concerning Treasury Share Acquisition
translation_en_brief:
KOHNAN SHOJI's board of directors approved on October 13, 2026 the acquisition of up to 450,000 treasury shares representing 1.51% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock as of August 31, 2026) for a maximum of JPY 1.5 billion. The acquisition will be conducted through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 14, 2026 and February 28, 2027.

The company cited two objectives: enhancing shareholder returns and improving capital efficiency, while enabling flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions. The company intends to continue treasury share acquisitions in the fiscal year ending February 2027 based on business performance and stock price levels. The company's dividend forecast for fiscal year 2027 shows increases of JPY 5 per share in both interim and final dividends, bringing the full-year dividend to JPY 140 per share.

For the medium-term business plan period 2025-2027, KOHNAN SHOJI targets a total return ratio of 40% or higher and progressive dividend growth.
